pool.text: Bukavu was established by the Congo Free State in the region.
The Congo Free State officially became the Belgian Congo.
The Swedish Pentecostal Mission founded its organization in Bukavu.
The city was named Costermansville or Costermansstad after Paul Costermans.
The name of Costermansville was changed back to Bukavu.
Rwandan government forces attacked Hutu camps at the start of the war.
Bukavu and Sud-Kivu saw sporadic fighting involving rebels and government forces.
Congo Handicap was created in Bukavu to support people with disabilities.
Protestors demonstrated against the United Nations after Bukavu fell to forces.
Fondation Chirezi launched a trauma healing and care project in Bukavu.
The population of the South Kivu Province capital was estimated at 806,940.
At least one policeman was killed during the South Kivu earthquake.
The urban population of Bukavu reached an estimated 1,133,000 residents.
The city of Bukavu suffered damage from severe flood events.
M23 rebels entered the city as part of a military campaign.
An explosion at a rally killed 13 people and wounded several.
